request.action_description: Attack 3 of 3, the finisher: she crouches and coils with both needles drawn back, then launches into a very long lunge and thrusts BOTH needles straight ahead together, ending exactly in the deep lunge pose of the end frame. Three-quarter FRONT view facing down-right every frame; the thrust goes down-right toward the camera side. She never turns away. Same character, outfit and size in every frame; no effects, no trails.
